from typing import List

def validateBinaryTreeNodes(n: int, leftChild: List[int], rightChild: List[int]) -> bool:
    if n == 0:
        return False

    # Check for exactly one root (node not appearing in leftChild or rightChild)
    children = set(leftChild) & set(rightChild)
    roots = set(range(n)) - children
    if len(roots) != 1:
        return False

    root = roots.pop()

    # Check for cycles and ensure all nodes are reachable from root
    visited = set()
    stack = [root]
    while stack:
        node = stack.pop()
        if node in visited:
            return False
        visited.add(node)
        left = leftChild[node]
        right = rightChild[node]
        if left != -1:
            stack.append(left)
        if right != -1:
            stack.append(right)

    return len(visited) == n
